caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across different categorical trigger words for three distinct insertion strategies ("start", "random", and "end") under the condition "AGNews, dirty-label, poison_num: 13". The x-axis is categorical and displays the sequence of words "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics", which are presented at a slight angle and without an overarching axis label. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and utilizes a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.1, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9. The "start" strategy is represented by a solid green line with small dot markers; it begins at approximately 0.75 for "cf", drops slightly to 0.72 for "bb", peaks at 0.91 for "WNBA", drops to 0.73 for "ESPN", rises to 0.87 and 0.88 for "NHL" and "FIFA" respectively, peaks again at 0.91 for "Estadio", and ends at 0.84 for "athletics". The "random" strategy is shown as a solid orange line with 'x' markers; it starts at 0.50 at "cf", rises to 0.54 at "bb", peaks sharply at 0.93 at "WNBA", falls to 0.63 at "ESPN", rises to 0.75 at "NHL", dips to 0.70 at "FIFA", rises to 0.83 at "Estadio", and concludes at 0.78 at "athletics". Finally, the "end" strategy is depicted by a solid purple line with circle markers; it starts at 0.62 at "cf", dips to 0.58 at "bb", reaches a prominent peak of 0.95 at "WNBA", declines to 0.72 at "ESPN", rises to 0.81 at "NHL", drops slightly to 0.79 at "FIFA", increases to 0.90 at "Estadio", and ends at 0.82 for "athletics".
